"""Read the visible 32-bit BGR framebuffer and save a PPM without changing it."""
import array
import fcntl
import os
import struct
import sys

fd = os.open('/dev/fb0', os.O_RDONLY)
try:
    var = array.array('I', [0] * 40)
    fix = bytearray(80)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd, 0x4600, var, True)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd, 0x4602, fix, True)
    width, height, _, _, xoffset, yoffset, bpp = var[:7]
    # fb_fix_screeninfo on this verified Linux aarch64 board: line_length at 48.
    stride = struct.unpack_from('I', fix, 48)[0]
    assert bpp == 32 and var[8:16:3].tolist() == [16, 8, 0]
    assert width <= 4096 and height <= 4096 and stride >= (width + xoffset) * 4
    with open(sys.argv[1], 'wb') as output:
        output.write(f'P6\n{width} {height}\n255\n'.encode())
        for row in range(height):
            bgra = os.pread(fd, width * 4, (row + yoffset) * stride + xoffset * 4)
            assert len(bgra) == width * 4
            rgb = bytearray(width * 3)
            rgb[0::3] = bgra[2::4]
            rgb[1::3] = bgra[1::4]
            rgb[2::3] = bgra[0::4]
            output.write(rgb)
    print(f'Saved actual framebuffer: {width}x{height}, stride={stride}, {sys.argv[1]}')
finally:
    os.close(fd)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then echo 'Usage: bash run-lab.sh /absolute/path/lab-st-2026 lab3|lab4|lab5_bt|test [program options]' >&2; exit 2; fi
project_dir=$(realpath -- "$1")
lab=$2
shift 2
case "$lab" in lab3|lab4|lab5_bt|test) ;; *) echo 'Unknown lab' >&2; exit 2;; esac
tool_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
check_options=()
remaining=("$@")
for ((i=0; i<${#remaining[@]}; i++)); do
    case "${remaining[$i]}" in
        --touch|--serial)
            if ((i+1>=${#remaining[@]})); then echo 'Missing device path' >&2; exit 2; fi
            check_options+=("${remaining[$i]}" "${remaining[$((i+1))]}"); i=$((i+1));;
        --headless) check_options+=(--headless);;
    esac
done
python3 "$tool_dir/preflight.py" --project "$project_dir" --lab "$lab" "${check_options[@]}"
run_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/run-$lab-XXXXXX")
cd -- "$project_dir/out"
echo "Log: $run_dir/run.log"
set +e
"./$lab" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$run_dir/run.log"
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
printf '\nProgram exit status: %d\n' "$status" | tee -a "$run_dir/run.log"
exit "$status"
if(!img1 || !img2 || !img3) { fprintf(stderr,"Missing test image/font assets\n"); return EXIT_FAILURE; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'Usage: bash verify-glyph-cache.sh /absolute/path/to/lab-st-2026' >&2; exit 2; fi
project_dir=$(realpath -- "$1")
prepared_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
check_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/glyph-cache-check-XXXXXX")
flags=(-O3 -Wall -I"$project_dir/common" -I"$project_dir/common/external/include")
renames=()
for function in fb_new_image fb_get_sub_image fb_free_image fb_read_jpeg_image fb_read_png_image font_init fb_read_font_image; do
    renames+=("-D$function=baseline_$function")
done
gcc "${flags[@]}" "${renames[@]}" -c "$prepared_dir/tests/image-baseline.c" -o "$check_dir/baseline.o"
gcc "${flags[@]}" "$prepared_dir/tests/test_glyph_cache.c" "$prepared_dir/common/image.c" "$check_dir/baseline.o" \
    -L"$project_dir/common/external/lib" -ljpeg -lpng -lfreetype -lz -o "$check_dir/check"
"$check_dir/check" "$project_dir/out/font.ttc" | tee "$check_dir/result.log"
